question: Who took oath as the Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh in June 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**N. Chandrababu Naidu**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 
 
• **N. Chandrababu Naidu** is a prominent Indian politician and the President of the **Telugu Desam Party (TDP)**, which was founded by his father-in-law Nandamuri Taraka Rama Rao (NTR). 
 
• He has served as the **Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh** multiple times, first assuming office in **1995** and leading the state through various terms with a focus on economic growth and technological development. 
 
• Under his leadership, Andhra Pradesh saw significant growth in the IT sector, earning him the title of the "**IT Visionary of India**." His efforts transformed **Hyderabad** into a global IT hub, with the establishment of major tech parks like **Cyberabad** and HITEC City. 
 
• In the **2024 Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly elections**, his party, the TDP, secured a majority, leading to his swearing-in as the Chief Minister of the state in **June 2024**. 
 
• Naidu is known for his administrative expertise and focus on development projects, including improving infrastructure, agriculture, and governance systems in Andhra Pradesh. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

__ 
 
• **N. Chandrababu Naidu's Political Career:** 
 
 
• He became the **youngest assembly member** and a minister at the age of **28** in the Congress government of Andhra Pradesh in **1978**. 
 
• In **1983**, he joined the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) and became a key player in its organizational structure. 
 
• He served as the **Leader of the Opposition** in the Andhra Pradesh Assembly during multiple terms when TDP lost power. 
 
 
 
• **Achievements as Chief Minister:** 
 
 
• Naidu's tenure is noted for his focus on **economic reforms**, making Andhra Pradesh a business-friendly state. 
 
• He introduced various welfare schemes, including programs aimed at improving **agriculture and irrigation**, such as the **Pattiseema Lift Irrigation Project**. 
 
• He played a pivotal role in the **division of Andhra Pradesh** and oversaw the development of the new state capital, **Amaravati**. 
 
 
 
• **Telugu Desam Party (TDP):** 
 
 
• The TDP was established in **1982** by NTR to represent the interests of the Telugu-speaking people. 
 
• It has been a major political party in Andhra Pradesh, with its ideology based on regionalism, development, and welfare. 
 
 
 
• **Other Candidates in the Question:** 
 
 
• **Revanth Reddy:** A prominent Congress leader from Telangana, not Andhra Pradesh, making this option incorrect. 
 
• **Mohan Yadav:** A BJP leader from Madhya Pradesh, unrelated to Andhra Pradesh politics. 
 
• **Vishnu Deo Sai:** A BJP leader from Chhattisgarh, also unrelated to Andhra Pradesh politics. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 

 
 
• **Economic Vision:** Naidu's policies focused on **digital governance**, e-governance initiatives like **e-Seva**, and promoting IT and software exports. 
 
• **Challenges Faced:** His tenure saw challenges, including public dissatisfaction with agricultural reforms and the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh. 
 
• **Recognition:** He has received several awards, including the **IT Indian of the Millennium** by India Today and recognition as South Asian of the Year by the **Time Asia Magazine** in **1999**.
